messages:
olivia: FYI --- ACME wants a short trial to validate a retrieval + tool-calling flow against their product docs. They're asking for scope, success criteria, security answers, and an upfront cost estimate. timeline requested: 6 weeks.

dan: quick q — what's the expected corpus size and average doc length? affects context strategy + embeddings.

olivia: corpora ~ 40k docs, many short (kb) but some long spec PDFs. must handle multi-doc answers + citations.

martin: suggested success metrics to propose: p95 latency < 700ms for median queries, answer relevance +15% vs current search baseline (offline eval), hallucination rate < 2% on safety eval set, and end-to-end cost <= $X per 1k queries. we can formalize after we see sample prompts.

mike: model fit notes: they asked about 64k context but starting with 32k is realistic. propose 32k long-context variant for hosted POC, with a Dedicated stress test for 64k if needed. for tool calling we need to validate function schemas (JSON-schema style) and ensure routing preserves KV cache across tool calls.

dan: for embeddings/rerank — do they want hybrid? vector-search + learned reranker? reranker needs labeled pairs (~2-3k) for decent lift. we can seed with crowd labels if they don't have labels.

priya: security flags from legal: SSO + SCIM, KMS integration, audit logs, data residency (EU), and an answered security questionnaire. they also want evidence of pen tests and SOC2.

security-bot: Upload: security-questionnaire-acme.pdf -> https://redwood.internal/q/ACME_SEC_Q (placeholder). Please attach answers under the ticket.

olivia: pricing — customer asked Hosted vs Dedicated delta. can PM a rough estimate? they expect a per-month predictable number for Dedicated for the pilot.

mike: rough thumb: Hosted POC (4w active + 2w analysis) using long-context 32k variants + embeddings ~ nominal credits we can cover with trial credits. Dedicated dev-sized pool for 6 weeks ~ monthly committed baseline + setup. I'll send a quick calc after I know expected QPS and peak concurrency.

martin: blocker: legal wants KMS/HSM proof before Dedicated kickoff. that will delay on-prem provisioning by ~2 weeks unless we use Hosted with encrypted-at-rest and customer KMS integration.

priya: also confirm network policy: they want IP allowlist + VPC peering. Hosted can do allowlist and private endpoints; Dedicated/Private supports full VPC. note: we need SOW amendment for Private.

olivia: OK — next steps propose: 1) send ACME our filled security questionnaire this week, 2) run a 4-week hosted POC with sample evals, 3) at week 3 run a Dedicated smoke test if they want reserved perf numbers. sound reasonable?

dan: yes. I'll draft eval harness: we'll need 300 seed prompts across intents, and 500 NIST-like safety check prompts. example eval command: `python eval_runner.py --model redwood-32k-long --prompts sample_prompts.jsonl --metrics rerank,bleu,precision_recall`

eva: for reranker training: recommend starting with 1k human-labeled pairs (positive/negative) and augment with synthetic negatives. embedding dim and index: 768 dims with HNSW index is fine; we can tune after initial results.

olivia: acme asked for timeline in writing. I'll propose: Week 0: security Qs + env setup; Weeks 1-4: hosted functional POC + offline evals; Week 3: optional Dedicated smoke test; Week 5: analysis + handoff + pricing proposal; Week 6: decision.

martin: propose success criteria doc to share with customer. include thresholds and example eval prompts. I'll draft and share.

priya: enterprise blocker reminder: we must get signed DPA and inbound dataflow diagram before any data onboarding.

olivia: noted. Dan, can you prepare the prompt seed and evaluation plan by EOD tomorrow?

dan: yes — I'll drop initial prompt set and a short README in the drive.

mike: I'll assemble a quick Hosted vs Dedicated cost sketch and include options: burst capacity, quantized model variants (8-bit) to reduce cost.

olivia: thanks everyone. I'll send ACME the timeline + questionnaire today and link back here. :thumbsup:

martin: :thumbsup: small ask — can we get a sample_pdf and a representative query log from them? makes evals way faster.

olivia: requested both. will share when received.

security-bot: Reminder: submit answers to security questionnaire by 1800700000 to meet customer's legal review window.

olivia: copying this thread into the deal workspace and tagging @sales_ops for contract steps.

mike: noted. prepping cost numbers once prompt set lands.

olivia: end.
